list.title: Domains
list.emptyDescription: Add a domain for tracking links, PWA installs or fallback destinations.

hints.pending: Waiting for the certificate to be issued

form.description: A domain of your own for tracking links, PWAs or fallbacks. After it is added FLOX checks its SSL certificate on its own; registrar and DNS actions are below on the domain's page.

errors.domain: Enter a valid domain, e.g. track.example.com

actions.removeDescription: Tracking links on this domain are removed with it, and campaigns using them stop resolving. This cannot be undone.

automation.title: Registrar & DNS
automation.description: Checks and actions through the Namecheap (registrar) and Cloudflare (DNS) accounts connected under Settings → Integrations. Other registrars and DNS providers are not managed by FLOX.
automation.noPermission: You don't have permission to do this
automation.needsCloudflare: The DNS provider must be Cloudflare
automation.verifiedDescription: Expiry and SSL status refreshed from the provider.
automation.httpsWorksDescription: Tracking links on this domain now use https.
automation.syncedDescription: A CNAME now points this domain at FLOX.
automation.renewDescription: FLOX renews the domain through your connected Namecheap account, which is charged for the selected number of years. This cannot be undone.
automation.syncDescription: FLOX creates or updates a proxied CNAME record in your connected Cloudflare account, pointing this domain at FLOX. Whatever the domain serves now will be replaced by FLOX.

ownership.title: Domain ownership
ownership.instructions: Prove you control this domain's DNS: add the TXT record below at your DNS provider, then check it. Until then the domain does not track — anyone can add a domain name, only its owner can verify it.
ownership.name: Name
ownership.propagation: A new record can take a few minutes to appear.
ownership.verifiedOn: Verified {{date}}. The TXT record can be removed.
